message.content: {"caption":"Archive tree and SWE-bench progress for DGM without open-ended exploration.","description":"Two panels compare an agent archive with its progress over iterations. Left: a branching tree of small circular agent nodes runs from the upper left toward the lower right, with a few short side branches. Nodes contain small numeric agent IDs, many too small to read, and their fill colors encode SWE-bench score on the adjacent vertical color scale, from 0 to 0.5. Thin gray links connect agents; there are no visible arrowheads or link labels. In the page context, the links represent self-modification from parent agents to offspring. The ring-color legend identifies red as “10 tasks (no basic functionality),” orange as “60 tasks,” and green as “200 tasks (score ≥ 0.4 and top two of archive then).” A star in the legend denotes the final best agent; no star is clearly visible on a node. Right: a line chart titled “DGM w/o Open-ended exploration Progress,” with Iterations on the x-axis (0–80) and SWE-bench Score on the y-axis (labeled from 0.15 to 0.50 in 0.05 steps; the plotted scale extends below 0.15). The legend shows Average of Archive (orange-red), Best Agent (orange), and Lineage to Final Best Agent (dark brown). The archive average starts near 0.20, falls to about 0.18 by iteration 10, remains around 0.18, then edges up slightly toward 0.185 by iteration 80. The best-agent line stays near 0.20 initially, declines to about 0.18, then rises to about 0.23 around iteration 38 and remains there through iteration 80. The dark lineage is jagged: it falls from about 0.20 to roughly 0.12, briefly rises near 0.17, drops again near 0.12, then fluctuates upward and ends near 0.23 around iteration 38; no lineage points
